total_pieces = int(input())
budget = int(input())
pieces = [int(input()) for _ in range(total_pieces)]

total_cuts = 0
odd_count = 0
even_count = 0
max_differences = []

for i in range(total_pieces):
    if pieces[i] % 2 == 0:
        even_count += 1
    else:
        odd_count += 1
    if even_count == odd_count and even_count != 0 and i != total_pieces - 1:
        max_diff = abs(pieces[i] - pieces[i + 1])
        max_differences.append(max_diff)

max_differences.sort()

for diff in max_differences:
    if budget >= diff:
        total_cuts += 1
        budget -= diff

print(total_cuts)
